question: The Index of Industrial Production (IIP) is an index that shows the growth rates in different industry groups of the economy in a fixed period of time. What is the base year of IIP?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thu Dec 01 2011 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The base year of the Index of Industrial Production (IIP) is **2011-12**.

• The IIP is used to measure the changes in the volume of production of a basket of industrial products during a given period.

• The IIP is an important indicator of the performance of the industrial sector of the economy.

• The IIP data is compiled and published by the Central Statistics Office (CSO) of the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Index of Industrial Production (IIP)**

• The IIP is an index that measures the growth rates in different industry groups of the economy in a fixed period of time.

• It is a key economic indicator of the manufacturing sector of the economy.

• The IIP is computed using the weighted average of the production indices of different sectors, such as manufacturing, mining, and electricity.

• The IIP helps in assessing the overall industrial performance and is widely used by government agencies, analysts, and researchers.

• **Base Year**

• The base year is the year against which the performance of other years is compared in index numbers.

• It serves as a reference point for the index calculation.

• The base year is periodically updated to reflect the changes in the industrial structure and production patterns.

• For the IIP, the current base year is 2011-12.

• **Central Statistics Office (CSO)**

• The CSO is a governmental agency under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.

• It is responsible for the coordination of statistical activities in India and for maintaining statistical standards.

• The CSO compiles and publishes various statistical data, including the IIP, GDP, and Consumer Price Index.

• Its primary objective is to provide reliable and timely statistical data for informed decision-making.
